global: A bowl of spicy ramen boasts a rich, crimson broth, topped with tender chashu pork and a generous mound of crisp bean sprouts. The white bowl with red trim sits on a dark table, illuminated by warm, ambient light.

regions.background: Dark, smooth, slightly reflective table surface with faint golden patterned tray visible at top edge.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with red stripes, smooth surface, circular rim, slight residue stains visible along inner edge.
regions.soup: The spicy broth is vibrant red, glossy, and thick, swirling around noodles and meat, topped with white bean sprouts.
regions.spoon: A red spoon with smooth, slightly reflective surface and rounded tip, showing subtle curvature and glossy finish.
regions.meat: Chashu pork pieces show caramelized, glossy brown surfaces with visible fat marbling and irregular, slightly curled shapes.
